Tests would be found in files like 'test/tx/NFTokenCreateOffer_test.cpp', 'test/tx/NFTokenMint_test.cpp', or similar. However, direct unit tests for these specific utility functions (canHaveNFTokenOfferID, getOfferIDFromCreatedOffer, insertNFTokenOfferID) may not exist unless explicitly written. Edge cases such as null transactions, failed transactions, or malformed nodes may not be fully covered unless negative tests are present. Template-based validation is not directly tested here but would be exercised via higher-level transaction tests.
